## Agent action

Code-only changes need no changelog entry. If this PR adds a hook, env var,
config key, systemd unit, hooks path, breaking default, or migration that
existing agents must or should adopt, add a row to `CHANGELOG.md`
tagged `optional`, `recommended`, or `required`.

- [ ] Needs agent action → `CHANGELOG.md` entry added
